Client task date2026-10-25 and actual report timestamps are recorded separately without changing the observed clock.
Raw article counts/words exclude duplicate_of captures. BrandShield has10 ARTICLE_BODY records but9 deduplicated bodies, removing one605-word exact duplicate; the resulting article-word total is8302.
Runner summary record words are report-retained text, not all acquired article words. Raw bodies include rejected sources and are not useful-evidence counts.
All published passages remain UNVERIFIED and independence_verified=false. Source span/hash fidelity does not verify source assertions.
Native HTTP admissions omit non-instrumented provider traffic; complete_network_accounting=false in every case. Counts77/93/88/77 are not total network requests.

Publisher link rejection events and accepted citation metadata describe different stages. Empty publisher_link_audit lists do not imply no article-citation candidates; the two Scout candidates have source_citation metadata and exact observed parent links.

Only one newly followed source-citation candidate became an acquired/qualified/published article: a Motley Fool transcript linked from a captured TechTimes article. It contributes2935 retained words and958 published words in9 passages. A second cited continuation remained unread at the read-attempt limit.

Publisher-continuation lineage includes same-publisher/resolver links and may be attached to previously known candidates. Its counts are not automatically additional sources attributable to the new crawler.

Source-ID/hash and passage-text overlaps are descriptive. URL variants, syndicated content, changing source availability, paragraph joining and duplicate suppression prevent causal or independent-source interpretations.
Scout includes4014 forecast-or-mixed financial-context words and1180 historical-context words in its7111-word workbench. They are labeled context, not current statement confirmation.
BrandShield remains SOURCE_REPORTS_ONLY; safety NOT_ESTABLISHED, threat_count=0 and safe_count=0. Source reports and preventive warnings are not confirmed threats.
Trending retains one source and322 published words; legacy safe_count=1 does not establish safety, exhaustiveness or independently verified trend coverage.

Personal Watch is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with zero qualified/published sources, identity_authenticated=false and identity_risk=UNASSESSED. The same484-word old article body is acquired but does not pass final qualification.
Published source grouping under the legacy independent evidence section is not verified publisher independence. Workbench accounting explicitly records independence_verified=false.

Null ratios have zero denominators. Internal excerpt-to-workbench ratios measure an additive projection, not all previously inspectable frontend text. No20x overall useful-evidence gain is established.
